{{Top|leg}}
A '''disrana''' was the early nomadic groupings of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] that lived on [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Weequay society was still loosely based on the concept and structure of the disrana.
